callText: Motorcyclist down after a collision with a car
location: Lorong 6 Toa Payoh, bus stop near Toa Payoh Central

caller.voice: A passer-by, shaken, in casual Singapore English. He doesn't know the rider. He knows only what he has seen: a motorbike and a car collided, the rider fell off and is lying on the road, his leg looks broken with a little blood, and he has taken his helmet off.

answers.location: Lorong 6 Toa Payoh, the bus stop near Toa Payoh Central.
answers.whatHappened: One motorbike and one car collide. The rider fell off his bike, now lying on the road. Young guy, maybe early 30s. He took off his helmet already.
answers.icAndMeds: I don't know him leh, his wallet maybe in his bag.
answers.criticalInjuries: His leg look broken, a bit of blood only.

patient.name: Faizal bin Rahim
patient.voice: In pain and shaken. Speaks in full sentences, a little breathless, and winces when he moves.
patient.chiefComplaint: My right leg, very pain. I fell off my bike.

lines.feelingNow: Breathing OK now. My leg still very pain.
lines.fall: Yes, I fell off the bike.
lines.hitHead: No, I had my helmet on. I took it off after.
lines.lungHistory: No, no asthma, no lung problem.
lines.verbal: Faizal bin Rahim. I'm at Toa Payoh, at the bus stop.
lines.motor: OK, both arms up, like this.
lines.position: Just let me lie here. Don't move my leg.
lines.bpScreen: No shunt, no fistula. Never had operation.
lines.ic: My IC is in my wallet, in my pocket.

hazards: traffic on the road beside the patient

spine.hitHead: No, I had my helmet on
spine.dtbl: No deformities, tenderness, bruises or lacerations

circulation.pulse: Radial pulse present, fast and strong

rbs.findings: Deformity and swelling of the right lower leg; pain at the upper back when pressed

limb.injury: Right lower leg, deformed and swollen
limb.distalPulse: Distal pulse present in the right foot.
limb.immobilise: Buddy splints the right leg as instructed.

investigation.auscultation: Air entry equal, breath sounds clear
